updates.body: Between November 9 and November 18, 2026, some Grafana Cloud users with Edit or Admin permissions on a data source may have experienced “permission denied” (403) errors when configuring or querying a newly created data source. A change to how data source permissions are stored caused these permissions to be incorrectly evaluated. We rolled back that change on November 18 at 17:27 UTC, preventing newly created permissions from being affected. However, access issues caused by permissions stored before the rollback may persist until an additional fix is deployed.
